name: Equipment
author: ct
description: Gear for any game with stats: slots as data ("Kind": "equip_slot": weapon, body, accessory — or outfit and jewellery in a novel), items become gear by two keys of their own JSON ("Equip": the equip type, "Traits": what they do while worn), optional "Archetypes" limits. Worn items feed the stats as a trait source, so battle attributes, checks and conditions follow at once. The item action action/equip uses the inventory's own target picker; scenario actions equip.put and equip.remove; condition equipped(who, item); the Equipment block of the character sheet.
